js: (() => { const Q = SB.D.questions; const mk = (f) => SB.polCompute(Q.map((q) => q.bonus ? -1 : f(q))); return JSON.stringify({ toutDaccord: mk(() => 0), toutGauche: mk((q) => q.dir < 0 ? 0 : 4), toutDroite: mk((q) => q.dir > 0 ? 0 : 4), toutSansAvis: mk(() => 2) }); })()

(async () => { const Q = SB.D.questions; for (let i = SB.quiz.state.i; i < Q.length; i++) { await FX.sleep(300); const q = Q[i]; if (q.id === "b-dalgona") { await FX.sleep(500); return "dalgona"; } SB.quiz.answer(q.bonus ? (i % 3 === 0 ? -1 : 0) : (q.dir < 0 ? 1 : 3)); } return 1; })()
